speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started, and has it been getting worse steadily? Have you noticed any recent injuries, insect bites, or changes in the color or temperature of the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear a "pop" or feel a snapping sensation at the moment of injury, and can you actively bend the tip of your finger down? I need to assess if the extensor tendon is intact or if you have suffered a mallet finger injury.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: You have a classic presentation of Mallet Finger, where the extensor tendon is ruptured or avulsed at the DIP joint. I will now order an X-ray to rule out any associated bony avulsion fracture. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray of the Right Hand
